items.title: Hermit-AI – An offline, privacy-first RAG chatbot for ZIM files
items.raw_excerpt:
chat with the entire Wikipedia library (and your own docs) without a single bit of data leaving my machine. What makes it different? Standard RAG often picks the wrong chunks or gets confused by similar articles. Hermit uses a Multi-Joint Architecture: Entity Extraction: It understands who or what you're asking about before searching.
JIT Indexing: It dynamically indexes only the relevant articles into an ephemeral FAISS index for every query.
Verification Gate: A final joint verifies the premise against the source text to kill hallucinations.

In recent years, the PC processor market has witnessed a long-absent state of intense competition. The once relatively stable competitive landscape has been reshaped by Apple’s M-series processors, which redefined perceptions of PC energy efficiency. AMD has also intensified its offensive, and with the rise of the AI PC concept, Intel is facing significant competitive pressure.

This new generation of AI PC platforms, combining high performance and energy efficiency, has become a key product for Intel to maintain its leadership in the PC market.

excerpt_i18n.en: Over the past year, XPeng's performance has been exceptional. Amid widespread industry pressure and intense competition over pricing and configurations, the company delivered over 400,000 vehicles for the year. At a recent global new product launch, XPeng unveiled four new models priced between 180,000 and 300,000 yuan, aiming for even higher sales. This growth stems from adjustments to its product lineup, shifting from a "single breakthrough" strategy to "multi-model synergy," integrating pure electric and extended-range vehicles into a unified platform. XPeng believes that with pure electric range now consistently between 600 and 800 kilometers, the marginal value of adding more batteries is diminishing. What truly differentiates the driving experience is energy consumption control, efficiency, and the underlying intelligent systems. In recent discussions with domestic and international media, XPeng's Chairman and CEO, He Xiaopeng, appeared confident, describing 2025 as a year of "steady progress and breakthrough." In his narrative, XPeng's focus is shifting from "survival" to "going further." The company's approach to globalization has also evolved. When discussing vehicle exports, He now emphasizes local R&D and manufacturing, as well as simultaneous development of left- and right-hand drive models, rather than the previous focus on channel expansion, certification compliance, and price competition. "We are entering a phase of genuine global development," He revealed, noting that in 2026, XPeng will not only begin mass production of its first co-developed model with Volkswagen in China in the second quarter but also expand into the Americas and establish overseas factories. For XPeng, 2026 marks a turning point, moving beyond the steady and cautious strategy of "steady progress for long-term success."
excerpt_i18n.es: El año pasado, el desempeño de Xpeng fue excepcional. En un período en el que la industria en general enfrentaba presiones y los precios y configuraciones alcanzaban límites extremos, la empresa logró entregar más de 400.000 vehículos durante todo el año. En su reciente lanzamiento global de nuevos productos, Xpeng presentó cuatro modelos nuevos, con precios que oscilan entre 180.000 y 300.000 yuanes, con la intención de impulsar aún más sus ventas. Este crecimiento en ventas se debe a un ajuste en la estructura de productos. Xpeng ha comenzado a pasar de un "enfoque en un solo punto" a una "colaboración entre múltiples modelos", integrando vehículos totalmente eléctricos y de autonomía extendida en una misma plataforma. Según Xpeng, dado que la autonomía de los vehículos eléctricos se ha estabilizado en el rango de 600 a 800 kilómetros, el valor marginal de añadir más baterías está disminuyendo. Lo que realmente marca la diferencia en la experiencia es el control del consumo de energía.

excerpt_i18n.en: On January 8, OpenAI launched the ChatGPT Health feature, which can answer health questions, connect to smart devices, and plan diet and exercise, with functions similar to "Ant Fortune." Following the popularity of Ant Group's "Ant Fortune," OpenAI has also decided to enter the AI healthcare field. It is reported that one month after the new version of Ant Fortune was released, its latest monthly active users reached 30 million, with daily user inquiries exceeding 10 million, doubling in just one month. The rapid development of Ant Fortune highlights that health is becoming an area of explosive demand. When OpenAI released the ChatGPT Health feature, it also stated that health has become the most common area for users to utilize AI, with over 230 million people worldwide consulting ChatGPT on health and fitness-related questions weekly. As the first professional AI health application, the December new version of Ant Fortune offers three major functions: health Q&A, health companionship, and health services, integrating full-chain services from daily health consultations to online consultations and offline medical visits. It connects to 5,000 hospitals nationwide and 300,000 real doctors for online consultations, and supports integration with smart devices from ten major brands including Apple, Huawei, OPPO, vivo, and Yuwell. The newly released ChatGPT Health feature is similar to Ant Fortune, offering functions such as health Q&A, report interpretation, and smart device connectivity, but it has not yet integrated medical resources and steps like appointment booking and online consultations. OpenAI stated that ChatGPT Health is currently only available to a small portion of users.
